added_failures_note: derived (0 added, no ids) from the reviewed run's own suite logs roadmap-suite-base.log and roadmap-suite-head.log via reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs; the reviewed manifest names those logs under test_logs rather than the canonical baseline_suite/after_suite fields, so the store's read-time annotation reports the count unmeasured even though the two logs are present.

findings.text: blocking: `_plan_dependency_satisfied` requires at least one `done` declaration, so a plan whose every section is deferred keeps its dependents blocked; §9 ("every section is done or deferred") and the locked decision deferred-counts-as-ticked=deferred-blocks ("a whole-plan dependency clears once no section is left implementable") both make that plan satisfy a whole-plan dependency, and the stricter rule re-introduces the forever-wait §9 exists to remove.

follow-on: the undeclared-authored-heading guard is a condition §9 does not state — an authored heading with no declaration is already §5's coverage control, and §9's predicate reads declarations only — so the extra block is behaviour beyond the goal.

item_verdicts.goal: the goal is §9 of reckon:a-plan-is-done-when-every-section-is-ticked — judge a roadmap dependency by the target plan's sections; the change adds `_plan_dependency_satisfied` and a declaration-aware `_section_satisfied` at reckon/roadmap.py:606 and :643 and routes every local whole-plan site through the helper, but adds an at-least-one-`done` condition §9 does not state.

justifications.goal_fidelity: the core rule lands at reckon/roadmap.py:643, but the at-least-one-`done` guard at reckon/roadmap.py:673 contradicts §9's "every section is done or deferred" and the locked decision, blocking an all-declared-deferred plan's dependents.
